title: The #1 Change I Made To Get Abs At 40
hook: The number one change I made to get six pack abs at 40 was not a workout.
body: I threw out every carb snack in my house. My meals were clean and I still wasn't lean, because of the chips, the crackers and even the healthy trail mix. I swapped all of it for protein and fat: hard boiled eggs, sardines and chipotle protein cups. Protein and fat fill you up, you hit your protein without trying, and after about three weeks you stop wanting the carb snacks at all.
close: Don't change your meals this week. Just change your snacks, then comment and let me know how switching to protein snacks works for you.
